name: long-read
what: Compaction: a 60k-token file read mid-task at a 32k context; compaction fires and the task still completes.
prompt: Read docs/big.log in full (the whole file, however many reads it takes) and count how many lines have status=500. Then create src/c.js exporting const c = 3 and run `node --check src/c.js`. Report the count and what you ran.
